observations.title: Semeru volcano (Indonesia)
observations.description: The Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG) reported that activity continued at Semeru during 17-23 September, with daily eruptive events recorded by the seismic network. White-and-gray ash plumes rose 200-1,000 m above the summit and drifted NE and E on most days; no emissions were visible on 19 September. The Alert Level remained at 3 (the second highest level on a scale of 1-4) and the public was warned to stay at least 5 km away from the Jonggring Saloko Crater in all directions, 13 km from the summit on the SE flank along the Kobokan drainage, and 500 m from the banks of the Kobokan drainage as far as 17 km SE of the summit. Source: Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG, also known as CVGHM)
